subtitle: Macro intelligence center integrating macroeconomic indicators, market sentiment, and sector capital flow analysis
overviewDesc: The Guardian terminal integrates <cyan>macroeconomic indicators</cyan>, <gold>market sentiment</gold>, and <emerald>sector capital flows</emerald> into a unified interface for real-time structural diagnosis of the overall market environment. A macro analysis terminal designed to observe the market's structural regime rather than individual securities.

topBar.title: Real-time Market Indicator Bar
topBar.desc: The Guardian top bar simultaneously displays <gold>Fear & Greed Index</gold>, <rose>VIX</rose>, and <cyan>DXY</cyan>. These three market temperature indicators provide an immediate assessment of the overall macro environment.

fearGreed.title: Fear & Greed Index
fearGreed.desc: A composite sentiment indicator derived from <gold>7 market data sources</gold> compiled by CNN. <emerald>Extreme fear zones have historically preceded reversals</emerald>; <rose>extreme greed zones have historically preceded corrections</rose>.
fearGreed.extremeFear: Extreme Fear — Panic zone, historically extreme levels
fearGreed.extremeGreed: Extreme Greed — Overheated zone, correction-preceding probability structurally elevated

vix.title: VIX Volatility Index
vix.desc: Forward 30-day implied volatility derived from <cyan>S&P 500 options</cyan> pricing. A key indicator for market uncertainty and risk premium levels.
vix.low: Low volatility — Stable environment, premiums compressed
vix.high: High volatility — Uncertainty elevated, risk premiums expanded

dxy.title: DXY Dollar Index
dxy.desc: U.S. dollar strength against a basket of 6 major currencies. <rose>Dollar strength generally creates headwinds for emerging markets and commodities</rose>; <cyan>impact on U.S. large-caps is mixed</cyan>.
dxy.tip: DXY rising: export/tech stocks tend to face headwinds. DXY falling: EM/commodities tend to show relative strength.

topBar.guide1: <gold>F&G ≤ 25</gold> + <rose>VIX ≥ 30</rose> simultaneous → <emerald>Historically extreme zone where panic-level reversals are frequently observed</emerald>
topBar.guide2: <gold>F&G ≥ 75</gold> + <cyan>VIX ≤ 12</cyan> simultaneous → <rose>Overheated zone where profit-taking pressure structurally increases</rose>
topBar.guide3: <rose>DXY surge</rose>: export/semiconductor headwind environment → <cyan>Domestic/defensive relative strength zone</cyan>

gravityGauge.title: GRAVITY GAUGE
gravityGauge.desc: Gravity Gauge composites <gold>price, volume, sentiment, and institutional positioning</gold> into a <cyan>single 0-100 score</cyan> quantifying overall market strength.
gravityGauge.guide1: <rose>Gauge ≤ 40</rose> → Bearish environment with dominant downward pressure observed
gravityGauge.guide2: <emerald>Gauge ≥ 60</emerald> → Bullish environment with upward pressure; <gold>40→60 transition zone</gold> carries elevated structural significance
gravityGauge.guide3: Gauge <cyan>consolidating near 50</cyan> → Directionally inconclusive, catalyst-awaiting environment

realityCheck.title: REALITY CHECK
realityCheck.desc: Diagnoses current macroeconomic state through <cyan>PRICE FLOW</cyan>, <gold>NDX/DOW 20-day moving averages</gold>, <rose>U.S. 10-Year Treasury yield</rose>, yield curve spread (2S10S), and real rates (REAL). V9.0 adds <emerald>Macro Tactical Alerts</emerald> for real-time bond/gold capital flow detection.

priceFlow.label: PRICE FLOW & Moving Averages
priceFlow.desc: <cyan>Price Flow</cyan> represents major index <gold>short-term momentum</gold>; <emerald>NDX/DOW 20D</emerald> indicates tech and industrial <purple>medium-term trend health</purple>. <gold>100%</gold> means all constituent stocks are above their 20-day moving average.

bonds.label: Rates & Bond Market
bonds.desc: <cyan>USO10Y</cyan> is the market's discount rate, <gold>2S10S</gold> is a recession leading indicator, <purple>REAL</purple> is inflation-adjusted real yield. <rose>Sustained yield curve inversion structurally elevates recession probability</rose>.

macroAlert.label: Macro Tactical Alert
macroAlert.desc: Simultaneous capital inflows into bonds (TLT) and gold (GLD) trigger a <rose>RISK-OFF ROTATION</rose> alert. This pattern indicates institutional participants rotating capital from equities to safe haven assets — a <gold>crisis precursor pattern</gold>.
macroAlert.riskOff: Bond + gold simultaneous rally → Safe haven preference expansion
macroAlert.riskOn: Bond + gold simultaneous decline → Risk asset preference expansion

realityCheck.guide1: <emerald>NDX/DOW 20D both at 100%</emerald> → Strong uptrend; <gold>pullbacks are interpreted as structural support zones</gold>
realityCheck.guide2: <rose>2S10S inversion (negative) sustained</rose> → Recession leading indicator with 6-18 month lead time; <cyan>defensive sector relative strength environment</cyan>
realityCheck.guide3: <rose>RISK-OFF ROTATION alert</rose> → Safe haven preference strengthening environment

rlsi.title: RLSI INSIGHT
rlsi.desc: RLSI (Real-time Liquidity & Sentiment Index) uses AI to synthesize <cyan>liquidity</cyan>, <gold>sentiment</gold>, and <emerald>technical indicators</emerald> in real time, generating session-specific structural insights. Active during regular trading hours only.
rlsi.sampleInsight: Post-FOMC minutes, the market maintains a growth-favoring regime with positive tech sector flow observed. Rate stabilization expectations are being reflected.
rlsi.guide1: <emerald>ALIGNMENT OK</emerald> state: RLSI insights are analytically valid
rlsi.guide2: RLSI <purple>session insights</purple> structurally summarize the current market environment
rlsi.guide3: <rose>PARTIAL state</rose>: Some data sources missing; <cyan>cross-verification with other indicators recommended</cyan>

breadth.title: MARKET BREADTH
breadth.desc: Market breadth analyzes <emerald>advancing vs declining stock counts</emerald> to assess the structural health of market rallies. When <rose>indices rise but most stocks decline</rose>, this indicates a narrow large-cap driven structure with elevated trend fatigue probability.
breadth.guide1: <emerald>A/D ratio ≥ 2:1</emerald> → Broad participation confirmed; structurally healthy trend environment
breadth.guide2: Index new high + <rose>Breadth < 50%</rose> → Narrow large-cap driven structure; <gold>trend fatigue probability elevated</gold>
breadth.guide3: <emerald>Breadth rebounding from lows</emerald> → Participation breadth expanding; <cyan>bottom formation indicated</cyan>

calendar.title: ECONOMIC CALENDAR
calendar.desc: Displays schedules and <rose>estimated market impact levels</rose> for key economic events including <gold>CPI, PPI, PMI, FOMC</gold>. Volatility structurally expands around <rose>HIGH-rated events</rose>.
calendar.guide1: <rose>HIGH event D-1</rose>: Volatility expansion is structurally anticipated
calendar.guide2: <gold>Post CPI/PPI release</gold>: Initial 30-minute moves carry high noise probability; <cyan>directional confirmation becomes valid at 1-hour mark</cyan>
calendar.guide3: <purple>FOMC ±1 week</purple>: VIX spikes frequently observed; <emerald>options premium expansion zone</emerald>

tactical.title: TACTICAL VERDICT
tactical.desc: Gemini 2.5 FLASH AI cross-analyzes <cyan>all Guardian data</cyan> to produce <gold>Status</gold>, <purple>Analysis</purple>, and <emerald>Outlook</emerald> in a 3-stage output. V9.0 incorporates <rose>VIX futures term structure</rose> and <gold>bond/gold capital flow</gold> cross-analysis for volatility anomaly detection.
tactical.sampleCurrent: 5-day trend shows growth-favoring regime (RISK_ON_GROWTH) with capital inflows observed into value, industrials, and financials.
tactical.sampleAnalysis: Market maintains resilient flow dynamics despite FOMC minutes uncertainty, with tech sector showing relative strength driven by AI thematic concentration.
tactical.sampleAction: Growth-favoring regime and stable flow data indicate continued tech-led upward momentum in the current market environment.

v9DeepAnalysis.title: V9.0 Deep Macro Analysis Indicators
v9DeepAnalysis.vixTerm: VIX vs VIX3M (futures term structure): Contango (VIX < VIX3M) = stable market state; Backwardation (VIX > VIX3M) = fear spike precursor pattern
v9DeepAnalysis.bondFlow: Bond capital flow (TLT): Rally indicates safe haven preference expansion → downside risk increase indicated
v9DeepAnalysis.goldFlow: Gold capital flow (GLD): Rally indicates inflation hedge / crisis sentiment → volatility expansion environment indicated

flowMap.title: FLOW TOPOGRAPHY MAP V3.0
flowMap.desc: Visualizes <cyan>real-time capital flows</cyan> across <purple>14 sectors</purple> (GICS 11 + <cyan>Semiconductors, Cybersecurity, Clean Energy</cyan>) through network topology. Node <emerald>size and color indicate inflow/outflow intensity</emerald>; <gold>connection lines represent inter-sector correlation</gold>. V9.0 adds <rose>Safe Haven</rose> nodes for bond/gold capital flight visualization.
flowMap.safeHaven: Yellow node (Safe Haven) = Bond/gold safe haven capital flow
flowMap.newSectors: V9.0 new: Semiconductors (SEMIS), Cybersecurity (CYBER), Clean Energy (CLEAN NRG)
flowMap.guide1: Capital-concentrating sectors (<emerald>large green nodes</emerald>) → <gold>Bullish structure confirmed for leading constituents</gold>
flowMap.guide2: Capital outflow (<rose>red nodes</rose>) to inflow sectors → <cyan>Sector rotation observed</cyan>
flowMap.guide3: <gold>Safe Haven node</gold> capital concentration → <rose>Risk-off environment with strengthening safe haven preference</rose>

sectorIntel.title: SECTOR INTEL
sectorIntel.desc: Provides each sector's <cyan>5-day trend</cyan>, <gold>volume intensity</gold>, and <emerald>constituent-level real-time pricing</emerald>. Structurally assesses whether the entire sector moves in unison or is driven by select individual stocks.
sectorIntel.guide1: <emerald>Sector-wide advance + volume expansion</emerald> → <gold>Broad-based bullish structure confirmed</gold>
sectorIntel.guide2: 5-day trend <cyan>negative→positive transition</cyan> → <emerald>Early reversal observed at transition zone</emerald>
sectorIntel.guide3: Sector <rose>top constituents advancing while remainder declines</rose> → <gold>Individual stock selection analysis more valid than sector-level thesis</gold>

gammaShield.title: GAMMA SHIELD™ V3
gammaShield.desc: Analyzes institutional dealers' <gold>gamma hedge positions</gold> in the <cyan>S&P 500 options market</cyan> in real time to structurally assess market <emerald>volatility direction</emerald> and <rose>sudden movement risk</rose>. V3 adds <gold>GEX trend</gold>, <cyan>SPY/QQQ individual GEX</cyan>, and <emerald>Gamma Flip Point</emerald>.
gammaShield.sampleInsight: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(+13), Squeeze 38%, ▼6,500(-5.7%) downside bias · ceiling 7,000

gex.title: Gamma Pressure (GEX Index)
gex.desc: Normalizes combined <cyan>SPY + QQQ</cyan> options gamma exposure (GEX) to a -100 to +100 scale. <gold>Positive (+)</gold>: dealer hedging stabilizes prices. <rose>Negative (-)</rose>: dealer hedging amplifies volatility. V3 adds <emerald>▲/▼ trend arrows</emerald> showing day-over-day GEX direction.

squeeze.title: Squeeze Risk
squeeze.desc: Measures the probability of short-gamma position holders being <rose>forced to cover (squeeze)</rose> due to sharp price movements. Explosive price movement potential structurally elevates above <gold>45%</gold>; <rose>≥70%</rose> is an extreme risk zone.

trigger.title: Trigger Band
trigger.desc: Analyzes S&P 500 <cyan>options chain open interest</cyan> to calculate institutional <emerald>price support (Put Floor)</emerald> and <rose>resistance (Call Wall)</rose>. V3 adds <gold>Gamma Flip Point</gold> showing the critical price where dealers transition from long to short gamma.
trigger.resistDesc: Call OI concentration zone → upside resistance
trigger.supportDesc: Put OI concentration zone → downside defense

spySplit.title: SPY / QQQ Individual GEX
spySplit.desc: V3 feature displaying SPY (S&P 500) and QQQ (Nasdaq 100) <cyan>GEX individually</cyan>. Comparing gamma regime divergence between the two ETFs captures <gold>internal market structure discrepancies</gold>.

flipPoint.title: Gamma Flip Point
flipPoint.desc: The <gold>critical price</gold> where dealer positions transition from <emerald>long gamma (stable)</emerald> to <rose>short gamma (volatile)</rose>. Distance (%) from current price is displayed; <rose>within 2% proximity</rose> triggers a regime transition warning.

directionalInsight.title: Directional Insight (V3 New)
directionalInsight.desc: V3 replaces static insights with dynamic, real-time data-driven insights outputting <cyan>price targets and directional bias</cyan> in the header. <gold>GEX intensity</gold>, <emerald>squeeze level</emerald>, <rose>directional bias and price targets</rose> are immediately visible.

aiIntegration.title: AI Integration (V3 New)
aiIntegration.desc: Gamma Shield data (GEX, Squeeze, support/resistance) feeds directly into <cyan>Tactical Insight AI</cyan>, enabling RLSI+Breadth+macro+<gold>options structure</gold> synthesis. Dealer gamma clamping, squeeze proximity, and options wall approach are automatically reflected in AI analysis context.

gammaShield.insightDesc: GAMMA SHIELD V3 auto-generates <cyan>current data-based directional insights</cyan> displayed in the header. Example insights by scenario:
gammaShield.insightLong: S&P 6,893 — Gamma strong(+45), Squeeze 12%, ▲7,000(+1.6%) upside bias · floor 6,800 (GEX ≥ +20: stable, range-bound)
gammaShield.insightShort: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(-30), Squeeze 62%, ▼6,500(-5.7%) downside bias · ceiling 7,000 (GEX ≤ -20: vol expansion)
gammaShield.insightSqueeze: S&P 6,893 — Gamma weak(+8), Squeeze 71%, direction-agnostic sharp move imminent · capital preservation priority (Squeeze ≥ 70%)
gammaShield.insightTrigger: S&P 6,893 — Gamma neutral(+15), Squeeze 28%, ▲7,000(+1.6%) · resistance 1.2% approach — breakout = surge, rejection = pullback
gammaShield.guide1: <emerald>GEX ≥ +20 + Squeeze LOW</emerald> → Dealer hedging stabilizes prices; <gold>volatility-suppressed range-bound zone</gold>
gammaShield.guide2: <rose>GEX ≤ -20 + Squeeze HIGH</rose> → Dealer hedging amplifies volatility; <cyan>structurally high bi-directional sharp movement probability</cyan>
gammaShield.guide3: <emerald>Gamma Flip Point within 2%</emerald> → Dealer regime transition imminent; <rose>volatility regime change preparation warranted</rose>

strategy.title: Structural Data Analysis Workflow
strategy.desc: A 4-step process for systematically interpreting Guardian's complete dataset to diagnose market structure — from macro environment to micro-level analysis.

step1.title: Step 1: Market Environment Assessment
step1.desc: Review <gold>Fear & Greed</gold> + <rose>VIX</rose> + <cyan>DXY</cyan> status bar to assess overall market temperature. <emerald>Extreme fear/greed zones</emerald> have historically preceded reversals.

step2.title: Step 2: Macro Environment Diagnosis
step2.desc: Verify macro structural health via <gold>Gravity Gauge</gold> + <purple>Reality Check</purple> + <emerald>Market Breadth</emerald>. <cyan>Broad participation + stable rates</cyan> indicate a bullish environment.

step3.title: Step 3: Sector Flow Observation
step3.desc: Identify capital-concentrating sectors via <purple>Flow Topography Map</purple> + <cyan>Sector Intel</cyan>. Read <gold>sector rotation direction</gold> and analyze leading constituents of inflow sectors.

step4.title: Step 4: AI Structural Analysis Review
step4.desc: <emerald>Tactical Verdict</emerald> and <cyan>RLSI Insight</cyan> AI analysis provides final market environment assessment. Combining with <gold>Dashboard individual ticker analysis</gold> enables macro-micro integrated analysis.
